newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX STAGNATES AT 103.283 PTS.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX STAGNATES AT 103.283 PTS.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds remained unchanged in Monday's trading at 103.283 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.009 points to 2.771 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, stagnated at 100.937 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.009 points to 2.312 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 0.361 points to 1,022.419.
